title: Beige Rubber “Feet” Spoil Elegant Look
text:
Beige Rubber “Feet” Spoil Elegant Look. This ZONESUM CERAMIC, MODERN, ELEGANT FLOWER VASE (8.75" Tall, 4.5" Opening, Silver) looks okay from a distance, but rather cheap up close. The beige rubber anti-slip “feet” really spoil the elegant look. The feet don’t match the black, gray, and silver exterior; they are visible when the vase stands on a flat surface; and they are placed unevenly so that they extend beyond the base.

The vase has a narrow opening, about 2’ wide and 4.5” long, so it is a bit of a challenge to arrange flowers in it. I don’t think that the opening is wide enough to accept any kind of frog to hold the flower stems.

To make a really nice flower arrangement, you need to start by replacing the beige rubber feet with black ones, or with green table-protector fabric.
